# ChartSwitcher (chat block)

• ChartSwitcher(title (static), data (static), styles? (static), style? (static), partsOfWhole? (static), ordered? (static), currency? (static), unit? (static), note? (static))
  - Description: A chart the user can switch between bar, line, area, pie and donut; styles that misrepresent the data are greyed out.
  - title: Card title, e.g. "Spending this week".
  - data: The points, in order.
    List of maps keys:
    * label - Category or x label.
    * value - The number.
  - styles: Styles offered in the toggle. Defaults to bar, line, area, pie.
  - style: The style shown first. Defaults to the first enabled one in styles. Must be one of: 'bar', 'line', 'area', 'pie', 'donut'
  - partsOfWhole: True when the values add up to a meaningful total (enables pie/donut). Defaults to false.
  - ordered: True when the points have a natural order such as time (enables line/area). Defaults to true.
  - currency: ISO currency code. Defaults to INR.
  - unit: A unit shown instead of money, e.g. "steps" or "hours".
  - note: Footnote text that replaces the automatic explanation of greyed styles.

ChartSwitcher(title, data, styles?, style?, partsOfWhole?, ordered?, currency?, unit?, note?) — a small chart the user can restyle (bar, line, area, pie, donut) with a toggle and 'same data, other styles' thumbnails; the block itself greys out styles the data cannot honestly show and says why. data is [{label, value}]. Set partsOfWhole=true only when values add up to a whole (enables pie/donut, max 6 items); ordered defaults to true (line/area need ordered data, set false for categories). styles defaults to bar, line, area, pie; style is the one shown first. Amounts are money (INR) unless unit is given. Sends no events; the style the user picks is visible to you in onScreen. Prefer it over VegaChart for one series of up to ~12 points. Example: card = ChartSwitcher("Spending by category", [{label: "Food", value: 8200}, {label: "Bills", value: 6400}], styles=["donut", "bar"], style="donut", partsOfWhole=true, ordered=false)
